mission.body: JK GLOTECH specializes in Meta- and Para-Aramid material R&D, overseeing the full process from fiber to finished garments. For nearly 20 years, we’ve partnered with leading companies to advance the flame-resistant market. Driven by the needs of Firefighting, Oil & Gas, Industrial, Chemical, and Military sectors, we ensure reliable solutions through strict global standards and testing. Experience true Global Standards with JK GLOTECH.

evTank.bannerDescription: A flexible, drive-through tube system that immerses and suppresses EV batteries within 30 minutes using minimal crew and water.
evTank.responseTitle:
Immediate & Efficient Response
Structure for EV Fire Incidents

feature1.title: Fast Deployment & Mobility
feature1.description: EV Tank can be quickly positioned at the rear or side of a vehicle, enabling immediate response right after arrival.

feature2.title: EV Battery Fire–Focused Response
feature2.description: Designed specifically for the unique characteristics of EV battery fires—reignition, extreme heat, and toxic gases—providing an optimized isolation and cooling system.

feature3.title: Bottomless Design for Space Efficiency
feature3.description: Unlike traditional water pools or containment units, its bottomless structure allows installation directly on the ground, minimizing spatial limitations and enabling flexible placement in tight environments.

scrollCards.introText: Core Technologies Enhancing EV Tank Field Response

card1.title: Bottomless mobile immersion system
card1.description: Push-in response with minimal site limitations.

card2.title: Intuitive operator interface
card2.description: Simple water controls and ports for quick use.

card3.title: Fast setup, low water use
card3.description: Four-person deployment, immersion in 30 minutes with 7–8 tons.

card4.title: Korea-made & patented
card4.description: Domestic manufacturing backed by multiple patents.

washer.bannerDescription: A flexible, drive-through tube system that immerses and suppresses EV batteries within 30 minutes using minimal crew and water.

feature1.title: Cross-Contamination Prevention Process
feature1.description: Designed to handle contaminated equipment within a controlled environment, significantly reducing the risk of secondary exposure and cross-contamination.

feature2.title: Multi-PPE Cleaning System
feature2.description: SCBAs, air cylinders, helmets, masks, boots, gloves, and other equipment can all be washed in a single machine, maximizing operational efficiency.

feature3.title: Disinfection Function Option
feature3.description: Disinfectant can be applied during the rinsing cycle, or a separate disinfection program can be used, removing up to 99.9% of harmful contaminants.

card1.title: Powerful Rotational Washing Technology
card1.description: High-pressure rotating wash arms and optimized nozzles effectively remove contaminants, carbon residues, and PAH particles from deep inside the equipment.

card2.title: Fast Washing Cycles
card2.description: Gloves and boots are cleaned within 3 minutes, and SCBA units and helmets within 8 minutes, ensuring rapid equipment turnaround in high-frequency response environments.

card3.title: Intuitive Touch UI
card3.description: A modern single-touch interface allows easy control of wash/rinse temperatures, detergent concentration, and program monitoring, supporting a wide range of operational settings.

card4.title: Minimized Exposure to Harmful Substances
card4.description: From loading contaminated equipment to completing the wash, the entire process occurs inside the machine—significantly reducing worker exposure to toxic and hazardous contaminants.

garment.bannerDescription:
The ENIGMA flame-resistant garment made with DuPont™ Nomex® fabric is a high-performance industrial
protective wear designed to safeguard workers from flash fires and arc flash hazards.

feature1.title: High Level of Flame Protection Based on International Standards
feature1.description: It meets global flame-resistant standards such as ISO 11612 and NFPA 2112, maintaining reliable protection even in flash fire and high-temperature environments.

feature2.title: Lightweight Comfort Unique to Nomex®
feature2.description: The soft texture and lightweight structure of Nomex® Comfort and Essential Arc fabrics reduce fatigue during long working hours..

feature3.title: Arc Flash Protection
feature3.description: Engineered with Nomex® Essential Arc fabric for arc flash protection, it provides HRC 2 (8 cal/cm²) or higher performance, with the jacket and pants each carrying their own certified Arc Rating.

middleHero.text:
It provides reliable protection in various high-risk work
environments through lightweight comfort, high durability,
and internationally certified safety performance

garment.ergonomicTitle: We deliver optimal solutions through innovative development

item1.title: Permanent flame resistance
item1.description: Nomex® possesses inherent, permanent flame resistance. Therefore, its protective performance does not diminish even after repeated wear and laundering.

item2.title: Enhanced Breathability and Workability
item2.description: Made with Nomex® Special Blended fabric, it is lighter and offers excellent breathability and moisture absorption, ensuring comfort even in high-heat environments.

item3.title: Various styles available
item3.description: With our in-house sewing facility, we provide fast feedback and customization tailored to client needs.

item4.title: Exceptional Heat & Flame Resistance
item4.description: This equipment uses 122 sensors to graph burn severity and tests in compliance with ASTM F1930.

item5.title: Providing field-appropriate fabrics and solutions
item5.description: Maintains fabric strength and durability even with repeated use in high-risk industrial environments such as oil & gas, electrical, and chemical plants.

glove.bannerDescription:
With ANSI/ISEA 105 Cut Level A5 performance and outstanding comfort,
you can experience top-level safety and ease on the job.

feature1.title: Permanent flame resistance + cut protection
feature1.description: The heat-resistant fiber structure of Kevlar® Engineered Yarn minimizes performance degradation under high temperatures, providing stable protection during heat-intensive tasks, sparks, and friction heat.

feature2.title: Ultra-Lightweight Design for Reduced Fatigue
feature2.description: Its lightweight yarn construction reduces bulk and hand strain, significantly lowering wrist and finger fatigue during repetitive or precision tasks.

feature3.title: Field-Optimized Engineering
feature3.description: Through repeated field testing across metalwork, automotive, utilities, and electrical industries, the glove delivers a balanced combination of protection, flexibility, and durability optimized for real-world work environments.

middleHero.text:
Experience the innovative flame and cut protection technologies of
the DEXCut-Pro Glove made with Kevlar® Engineered Yarn.

item1.title: High Cut Resistance
item1.description: Delivers top-tier cut protection meeting ANSI/ISEA 105 Level A5.

item2.title: Superior Comfort & Grip
item2.description: A core metal-fiber structure enhances stability, ensuring exceptional comfort and grip.

item3.title: Multi-Hazard Protection
item3.description: Engineered to protect against multiple hazards rarely covered by standard cut-resistant gloves.

item4.title:
Advanced Kevlar®
Engineered Yarn
item4.description: Lightweight and flexible yarn reduces fatigue and supports precision tasks.

item5.title: Versatility Across Industries
item5.description: Meets global standards and is suitable for steel, automotive, utilities, and various industrial environments.
